answer: Attention Decay Credentialing: each identity must present a continuous stream of distinct, verifiable micro-tasks solved in real time, scored by a randomized panel that samples behavior like a plume drifting across sessions. Missed intervals degrade the credential below a threshold, blocking transactions until rebuilt. A pearl of consistent history cannot be bought in bulk. Because sustained attention is capacity-limited, an attacker's marginal cost scales with each identity's parallel upkeep; a sudden gale of registrations starves existing ones of review bandwidth.
